LESSON: READING 5.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: ORAL NARRATIVES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Oral Narratives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Oral Narratives, part of Strand 5 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to learn about heroes in society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. predict the actions of characters in legends,

2. read a heroic narrative- (legends) aloud in turns,

3. identify the characters in legends,

4. discuss heroic acts in the legends,

5. relate legends to their actions,

6. identify and discuss the moral lessons learned from legends,

7. reflect on the impact of their actions on the society,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. predict the actions of characters in legends,
2. read a heroic narrative- (legends) aloud in turns,
3. identify the characters in legends,
4. discuss heroic acts in the legends,
5. relate legends to their actions,
6. identify and discuss the moral lessons learned from legends,
7. reflect on the impact of their actions on the society,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Oral Narratives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: It is enhanced as the learner reads about legends and discusses the moral lessons learned from the legends.

• Critical thinking and problem-solving: It developed as the learner prepares and studies instructions on how collecting

narratives can be conducted in the community.

Values

Patriotism is enhanced as the learner reflects on the impact of the actions of the heroes and heroines on society.
